root_cause.text: The use of cancel_delayed_work_sync() in peer MEP deletion left a window where br_cfm_frame_rx() (running in softirq under RCU) could re-schedule the delayed work after cancellation but before freeing, causing use-after-free when the work executes on freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message detail the race: cancel_delayed_work_sync() returns, then br_cfm_frame_rx() re-schedules ccm_rx_dwork via ccm_rx_timer_start(), and later the work runs on the freed peer_mep. The patch replaces cancel_delayed_work_sync() with disable_delayed_work_sync() in the deletion paths to prevent re-scheduling.

intent_record.how: Ensures the delayed work ccm_rx_dwork is fully stopped and synchronized before freeing the peer_mep structure, preventing a potential race condition where the work could run after memory deallocation.
